notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 90–93, § 4, Sept. 27, 1967, 81 Stat. 229, which directed the Secretary of the Interior to apportion the judgment funds among the tribal groups based proportionally on the number of enrollees of each group, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
